title: Click-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Nestled among mossy brass polyhedrons in twilight-blue water, this curious cephalopod spends its hours sorting luminous sea glass into intricate, ever-shifting mosaics with soft, rhythmic clicks. Whenever it discovers a pleasing new symmetry—or spots a visitor peering in—constellations of warm amber and cyan ripple across its skin like visible daydreams.
